\section{A double hyphen in prose}

This sentence contains a bare double hyphen -- outside any verbatim
environment and outside any texttt span, so TeX would typeset it as an en dash
and the rule exists to stop exactly that.

This one is worse: it contains a triple hyphen --- which TeX typesets as an em
dash, which is the character the project bans outright.

The linter must report tex-ligature for this file.
